notes: Of-record matrix for the RAG paper (plan of 2026-09-26). Condition ids match the paper: C0, C1, C2a/b/c, C3.

C2b (reranker) is implemented (needs sentence-transformers; model BAAI/bge-reranker-base or AGENTIGRID_RERANKER_MODEL). Its thresholds must be fixed from labeled pairs and added to the C2b env as AGENTIGRID_CRAG_TAU_LOWER / _UPPER before the of-record run; until then C2b uses the cosine defaults 0.30/0.50 on reranker scores (pilot only). C2c (reranker_calibrated) and C3 (graph) are not implemented yet; the runner refuses them unless --skip-unimplemented is passed.
C2c is gated: run it only if C2b beats C2a (paper H4).
case39 carries the economic goals only (no contingency file ships with ExaGO for case39).
ACTIVSg200 files are read from ../datafiles (the ExaGO distribution); N-1 uses its shipped contingency file with all contingencies (AgentiGrid passes -scopflow_Nc -1).

Localized goals (relieve, voltage) run on PFLOW because OPFLOW enforces line ratings and the voltage band as hard constraints. Pre-check pending: if the base PFLOW solve of ACTIVSg200 shows no overload / voltage violation, replace the pflow case path with a frozen stressed variant.

Goal attainment: cost10 by target_pct; n1 by success=n1_secure (feasible SCOPFLOW solve with -ctgcfile and -scopflow_Nc -1); relieve/voltage by success=no_violations; loadmax has no attainment predicate. A cell whose baseline already attains the goal (baseline_attained=1) measures nothing and must be fixed before analysis.
Run from the agentigrid project root with the venv active and OLLAMA_HOST set.

goals.text: Find the maximum uniform load scaling factor before the system becomes infeasible
Find the minimum cost dispatch that survives all N-1 contingencies
Relieve all overloaded transmission lines while keeping bus voltages within their limits
Eliminate all bus voltage violations while keeping line loadings within their ratings
